title: Location-allocation: 2-median
query: demand.csv has 40 demand points with populations, and candidates.csv has 8 candidate facility sites. Choose the 2 sites that minimise the total population-weighted straight-line distance from each demand point to its nearest chosen site. Which two sites, and what is that total in person-kilometres?

expected_why.sites: exhaustive over all 28 pairs, geodesic distances

answer:
Based on the computation performed on your uploaded files, here are the results:

## Answer

**The two optimal sites are C1 and C3.**

**Total population-weighted straight-line distance: 382,254.14 person-kilometres** (≈ 382,254 person-km).

### Method
- Computed the great-circle (haversine) straight-line distance from each of the 40 demand points to each of the 8 candidate sites.
- For every one of the C(8,2) = 28 possible 2-site combinations, assigned each demand point to its **nearest** chosen site and summed `population × distance`.
- Selected the combination with the smallest total.

### Ranking (top 5 of 28 combinations)

| Sites | Total (person-km) |
|-------|-------------------|
| **C1, C3** | **382,254.14** |
| C2, C3 | 418,879.72 |
| C7, C8 | 420,410.88 |
| C1, C7 | 423,999.04 |
| C3, C7 | 428,722.67 |

The best pair (C1, C3) beats the runner-up (C2, C3) by about 36,626 person-km, so the choice is clear-cut.
